The '''Sesseranda Ocean''' was the body of [[water/Legends|water]] that covered most of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]].<Ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref> 

It was characteristically cold, shallow and stormy, dangerous for most aquatic vessels. It featured several archipelagoes and atolls, such as the [[Korinth Archipelago]].<Ref name="guide" />

It became polluted during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] when the major company [[Plextech Plastic Corporation]] began to dump its noxious by-products into its depths.
